items: Online reviews are still where most customers first find and judge your business, and stronger ratings bring more trust, more visits and more revenue.
For multi-location brands, a bad experience at one store reflects on the whole brand, so every location's reviews need consistent attention and replies.
Replying to every review, positive or negative, shows guests they're heard and gives you a chance to win back unhappy customers before they leave for good.
Surveys and loyalty offers can increase review volume, grow your customer database and bring guests back to redeem rewards.
Treat review data as free business intelligence, and analyze recurring themes to improve operations and stay ahead of competitors.
